source_as_of: The portal footer reports last modified 2026-09-07; individual page data has no common snapshot date.
scope: NCTE-recognized teacher-education institutions searchable by state/district, programme, institution name and file number; paginated regional-committee results include institution details and multiple course/order records.
scope_caveats: A recognized-only view is not proof that an omitted institution is unrecognized.
Recognition histories include initial, revised, withdrawal, restoration, continuation and court-order records; resolve the latest operative decision per institute/course/session.
The example region URL is not a national endpoint. A complete acquisition must enumerate all regional committees, filters and pages.
Drop contact names, personal phone numbers and email addresses from the institution catalog.
acquisition_caveat: The official paginated portal is readable, but a complete all-region/all-programme roster was not materialized. Direct shell acquisition was unavailable. No recognition conclusions or counts are asserted by this manifest.
